title: Constant-gap entanglement distillation for diagonal invariant states and quantum reset channels
provenance: Same reviewer involved in earlier exact manuscript and dossier audits; expanded exact-version review, not blind or an additional independent vote. No subagents. Prior evidence reused only with stated scope and identity checks; grades independently chosen for this exact manuscript.

score_rationale.technical: The complete integrated proof is coherent and operationally specified: actual-survivor seed, counted assistance, public-transcript security, valid source hypotheses, finite coding for arbitrary infinite-entropy reset densities, reproducible supplement and legible 15-page PDF. No unresolved material objection. The review is neither formal verification nor independent human scrutiny.
score_rationale.importance: An exceptional specialized theoretical contribution: a universal coherent-block distillation lower bound yields absolute dimension-independent intervals for two broad established invariant classes and removes all marginal restrictions from pure/separable constant irreversibility. The unrestricted mixed-MC recovery, identity/EB and oscillator applications demonstrate reach of one mechanism. This judgment is based on that finite-dimensional structural theorem, not on counting corollaries or inheriting earlier grades. Existing protocol primitives and known special cases, nonoptimal constants, loose small-dimension bounds, asymptotic inefficiency and a limited priority search prevent a field-shaping/historic rating.
